broadRoot.zh-CN: 禁止直接搜索根目录 /，全盘扫描耗时长且范围过大。
broadRoot.en-US: Searching the root directory / directly is slow and too broad.

useTrash.zh-CN: 请使用 trash 命令替代，文件移入回收站可恢复，更安全。
useTrash.en-US: Use the trash command instead; files can be restored from the trash.

useEdit.zh-CN: 请使用 edit 工具替代，更安全且效果相同。
useEdit.en-US: Use the edit tool instead; it is safer and has the same effect.

broadHome.zh-CN: 直接操作 ~ 目录效率低下且范围过大，请指定具体子目录路径。
broadHome.en-US: Operating on ~ directly is broad and inefficient; specify a concrete subdirectory.

needConfirm.zh-CN: 请与用户确认后再执行。
needConfirm.en-US: Confirm with the user before executing it.

rejected.en-US: The user rejected the dangerous operation: {label}

mavenBlocked.zh-CN: 禁止直接调用 Maven：编译、测试、构建、启动请使用 {skill} skill。
mavenBlocked.en-US: Direct Maven calls are blocked: use the {skill} skill for compilation, tests, builds, and startup.

shellParseBlocked.zh-CN: 无法完整解析 Bash 命令，已为安全起见阻止执行。
shellParseBlocked.en-US: The Bash command could not be parsed completely and was blocked for safety.

bashScopeBlocked.zh-CN: Bash 命令中的本地路径只能指向当前目录、已通过 add_directory 加入的目录、skills 目录、/tmp 或 /var。
bashScopeBlocked.en-US: Local paths in Bash commands may only point inside the current directory, directories added through add_directory, skills directories, /tmp, or /var.

configObjectRequired.zh-CN: 配置必须是 JSON 对象。
configObjectRequired.en-US: Configuration must be a JSON object.

configSkillRequired.zh-CN: javaSkill 必须是非空字符串。
configSkillRequired.en-US: javaSkill must be a non-empty string.

configInvalid.zh-CN: 安全守卫配置错误，已阻断 Bash。请修复配置并 /reload：{error}
configInvalid.en-US: Invalid safety configuration; Bash is blocked. Fix the configuration and /reload: {error}
